rules.legal_basis: Rozhodnutie predsedu NR SR c. 145/2026 Z. z. z 23. 6. 2026 (vyhlasene 24. 6. 2026); zakon c. 180/2014 Z. z.
rules.electoral_system: Starosta/primator and predseda samospravneho kraja are elected in a single round; the candidate with the most valid votes wins (relative majority). Regional chairs single-round since 2017. No source found indicating a 2025/2026 change re-introducing a 2nd round or a turnout/vote quorum; 2026 explainers (SME, Aktuality) still describe single-round plurality.
rules.tie_rule: Pri rovnosti hlasov sa podla zakona vykonaju nove volby (municipal).

moratorium.length: 48 hours before election day (plus election day until polls close)
moratorium.covers: campaigning, information on candidates for/against them in broadcast and print, publishing results of election polls and election 'ankety', political advertising
moratorium.note: Moratorium is 48h, not 14 days; regional polls were still being published on 20 Oct 2026 (SANEP for ta3).

withdrawn_candidates.rule: A candidate may withdraw (or be recalled by the nominating party) at the latest 48h before polls open (by 2026-10-22 07:00). If withdrawn after registration, the candidate's data REMAIN on the printed ballot, the withdrawal is posted in polling rooms, and the candidate is disregarded when allocating the mandate (votes cast for them are not counted toward a winner).

rules.no_voter_cards: Voter cards (volicsky preukaz) are not issued; vote only at place of permanent residence.

incumbency_evidence.finding: 2022 regional chairs: 7 of 8 winners were incumbents (Droba BSK, Viskupic TTSK, Baska TSK, Jurinova ZSK, Lunter BBSK, Majersky PSK, Trnka KSK). The only incumbent defeated was Milan Belica (NSK, NEKA), beaten by Branislav Becik (Hlas-SD, Sme rodina) with 27.49 %.
2022 winning shares of incumbent zupani (plurality, single round): Droba 63.60, Baska 67.25, Trnka 51.31, Lunter 47.53, Majersky 42.01, Viskupic 38.56, Jurinova 32.04 %.

2017 regional chairs (first single-round election, turnout 29.95 %): anti-incumbent wave against Smer - Smer lost four regions; incumbent Kotleba (BBSK, LSNS) lost to Lunter by >20 p.b.; Jurinova defeated incumbent Blanar (ZSK); Majersky defeated incumbent Chudik (PSK); Belica (NSK, Smer) retained. Exact count of re-elected incumbents not compiled here.

2026 status: all 8 incumbent zupani (Droba, Viskupic, Baska, Becik, Jurinova, Lunter, Majersky, Trnka) appear as 2026 candidates in bookmaker markets and polls. Bookmakers make the incumbent favourite in all 8; in 7 at <=1.15 decimal, while KSK is near a toss-up (Trnka 1.75 vs Porvaznik 1.95 at Tipsport).
2022 mayors: independent (NEKA) candidates won ~1,350 municipalities (~47 % of all).
Nationwide municipal incumbent re-election rate (share of running starostovia re-elected) for 2018/2022: NOT FOUND in this research pass; no SGI/Transparency figure located. Treat as unknown (null).

key_events.text: PM Fico (Smer) said he favours moving the municipal and regional elections to 2027; this did not happen, elections were called for 24 Oct 2026.
Speaker Richard Rasi signed the decision calling the combined elections for 24 Oct 2026 (145/2026 Z. z., published 24 Jun); campaign officially started 24 Jun.
Parliament passed a no-confidence vote in Environment Minister Tomas Taraba (SNS nominee), with SNS MPs voting for it; SaS leader Grohling said it proves the coalition lacks a majority.

President Pellegrini dismissed Taraba; PM Fico temporarily runs the environment ministry. Open coalition crisis: Fico publicly floated early elections, Hlas (Sutaj Estok) rejects them; Smer admits governing will need 'enormous effort'.
NMS: half of the population supports early elections, including half of Hlas voters; PS lead over Smer narrowed to 1.7 p.b.

Infostat (state statistical office affiliate) poll puts Smer first (19.0) ahead of PS (18.5); SANEP (Sept) also has Smer first, while NMS/AKO/Ipsos/Focus have PS first or tied. National race is roughly a PS-Smer tie.
Opposition planned joint rally on Namestie SNP in Bratislava; friction among opposition parties (SaS and Hnutie Slovensko criticised PS, KDH, Demokrati over a joint press conference).

Bloc pattern for zupani: opposition (PS, SaS, KDH, Demokrati, Hnutie Slovensko, OKS, Za ludi...) jointly back Droba (BSK), Viskupic (TTSK), Svitkova (TSK), Varga (NSK), Jurinova (ZSK), Majersky (PSK), Porvaznik (KSK). Coalition (Smer, Hlas, SNS, often Republika) jointly back Gajarsky (BSK), Hambalek (TTSK), Baska (TSK), Becik (NSK), Choma (ZSK), Simko (KSK). Lunter (BBSK) runs as NEKA and said he accepts Hlas support (aktuality interview). KSK and PSK both have incumbents running vs. a bloc challenger; in KSK incumbent Trnka is not the opposition bloc's candidate.

Bratislava: Martin Winkler (Dunaj) withdrew and endorsed Jozef Raz (Transport Minister, NEKA, backed by government parties; Fico said a Raz win would be a Smer success). Heredos withdrew for health reasons; Cahojova withdrew before registration. Race now Vallo (Team Bratislava, PS, SaS, Demokrati) vs Raz.
ZSK: Adam Lucansky (SNS) withdrew live in JOJ 24 debate in favour of coalition candidate Igor Choma.
KSK: Tibor Geci withdrew and endorsed coalition candidate Igor Simko.
PSK: Judita Lassakova (Smer MEP), Monika Leskova and Zoltan Kaso withdrew from the zupan race.

Pollsters (Focus' Slosiarik): in Bratislava government-aligned parties (Smer, Hlas, SNS, Republika) won about a third of votes in the 2023 parliamentary election; outcome depends on relative mobilisation.
Ministry of Interior published first central electronic register of all candidates in the combined elections.
